g1_temporal.definition: avg3/avg6/lifetime ratios and differences for mou/qty/rev; mou_Mean and rev_Mean versus avg3 are explicitly undated comparisons
g1_temporal.window_caveat: avg3=3 months; avg6=6 months; _Mean window unspecified. No inferred 3/4-month _Mean, time-normalized acceleration, or reinterpretation of change_* percentages as absolute changes.

g2_range.reason: Neither supplied CSV contains _Range columns; totmrc_Range, ovrrev_Range, mou_Range cannot be tested. No invented fields or reconstructed volatility.

g5_equipment_cycle.definition: retain v1's valid eqpdays/(30.4375*max(months,1)), without duplicating it; add valid eqpdays/max(phones,1), months%12, and hnd_price exact observed price tiers, m=50 encoding. Every training value is inner-OOF; inference maps fit training only.

g6_tenure_pricing.definition: nonnegative totmrc_Mean/max(tenure-decile train median,1); tenure quantile edges, missing-tenure fill and price medians fit exclusively on the current fitting rows

interval: corrected t: variance*(1/10+outer test/train=.25), conservative df=4
primary_auc: raw-score sample ROC AUC; calibrated AUC reported separately
primary_tail: Brier/logloss of prior-shifted probabilities on outcome-reweighted outer samples in the baseline-defined nominal weighted10% tail; cutoff comes ONLY from the outer-training internal calibration slice
tail_gate: corrected 95% upper<=0 for paired Brier/logloss degradation on baseline-fixed AND own-policy tails; no noninferiority margin
restricted_rows: exact original train+validation only; no original 10k/15k decisions
execution: sequential CPU; fixed specs, no sweeps; predictions cached, models not persisted
